Bangladesh Bowls Out Australia for 198 in First Test Match

In the first Test match between Australia and Bangladesh in Darwin, Bangladesh's bowlers, particularly Hasan Mahmud, dismissed Australia for 198 runs. Hasan Mahmud took six wickets, including openers Jake Weatherald and Travis Head. The match marks Bangladesh's return to playing a Test match on Australian soil after 2003. The Darwin pitch offered assistance to fast bowlers in the initial hours.
